      About
      
    

    

      
A notepad.
Created for more.
Words aren't just enough.

      
Blank is like a notepad for all your private data: meeting notes, shopping lists, favorite music. Think of it as an extension of your phone. Everything is stored on your device, using templates that look like single-page websites or mini apps. You just pick a template you like, and interact with it.

      
Every page lives in your private collection on this device. You can put a copy out into the world — publish to the Community tab, send it as a personal mail, or share a short link (handle/link) that opens it anywhere. See something you like out there? Clone it and make it your own.

      
None of this needs a phone number, an email, or a profile. Claiming a handle just generates a private identity token, stored only on your device — it's what lets you post, message, and restore your identity on a new device if you back it up. Nothing about who you are is ever collected.

      Privacy Policy
      
    

    

      
Effective 2 August 2026

      
Blank: A Notepad is published by Essential Software. This policy describes what data the app stores, where it lives, and what leaves your device.

      
On-device storage

      
All pages, edits, progress, favourites, preferences, Gallery snapshots, and UI state are stored locally on your device. None of this is transmitted to Essential Software.

      
External images & embeds

      
Images embedded in pages via URL are fetched directly from their source. YouTube embeds load directly from YouTube. Essential Software has no involvement with these third-party hosts.

      
AI writing assistant

      
The AI assistant sends your typed prompt (not the content of any existing page) directly to the API provider you choose. Your API key is stored only on your device and is never transmitted to Essential Software. Requests go directly to the provider.

      
Identity & handle

      
Your identity token is generated on your device and stored locally. It is transmitted to the community database only when you claim a handle or perform a community action. Your handle, once claimed, is stored in the community database and is publicly visible. Essential Software does not link your handle to any personal information.

      
Messages

      
Messages you send are end-to-end encrypted on your device (AES-GCM with RSA-OAEP key exchange) before being transmitted to the community database. They are attributed to your handle. Essential Software cannot read message content.

      
Community tab

      
The Community tab connects to a database to load, post, and like public pages. Posts are attributed to the handle you provide and are visible to all users. Any images embedded in a community post are uploaded to a public cloud storage bucket and given a public URL — this URL is reachable by anyone on the internet, not just people using the app, and is separate from the on-device Gallery. Deep link lookups transmit only the page ID.

      
Analytics

      
Essential Software does not collect analytics, telemetry, or crash reports from this app.

      Consumer Terms
      
    

    

      
Effective 2 August 2026

      
Using Blank: A Notepad means you agree to these terms.


      
Responsible Use

      
You agree to use Blank for lawful purposes only. You may not use the app to store, transmit, or publish content that is illegal, harmful, threatening, abusive, defamatory, or infringes on the rights of others. Essential Software reserves the right to remove content that violates these terms.

      
You are responsible for maintaining the security of your identity token. Essential Software cannot recover a lost token or restore access to a handle if your token is deleted.


      
Community Guidelines

      
The Community tab is a shared space. When participating, you agree to:

      
    
        
  • Post only content you have the right to share.
    • 
        
  • Treat other users with respect. Harassment, hate speech, and targeted abuse are not permitted.
    • 
        
  • Not impersonate other people or handles.
    • 
        
  • Not use automated tools to spam, flood, or manipulate community rankings.
    • 
        
  • Not post spam, advertising, or promotional content outside of designated boost channels.
    • 
      

      
Essential Software may remove community posts that violate these guidelines without notice.

      
Images embedded in a community post are hosted at a public URL, separate from the post itself. When you delete a post, Essential Software makes a best-effort attempt to also remove its hosted images, but removal is not guaranteed.


      
Advertiser Terms

      
If you promote pages using the Boost feature, the following terms apply in addition to the above.


      
Boost Period & Availability

      
Boost periods are measured in calendar days from the date of purchase. Days count continuously, including weekends and public holidays. Boost days continue to count even if the app or its servers are temporarily unavailable — for example, due to scheduled maintenance, unexpected downtime, or connectivity issues on your end. Essential Software does not pause or extend boost periods on account of service interruptions.


      
Refund Policy

      
All boost purchases are final and non-refundable, except where required by applicable law. If your payment is processed but your boost is not activated within 24 hours, contact Essential Software for resolution. Refunds will not be issued for:

      
    
        
  • Unused days remaining at the end of a boost period.
    • 
        
  • Boost periods affected by temporary service unavailability.
    • 
        
  • Accidental purchases or change of mind.
    • 
        
  • Pages removed for violating community guidelines during a boost period.
    • 
      

      
To request support for a billing issue, contact Essential Software.


      
Changes to These Terms

      
Essential Software may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the app after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.


      
Contact

      
For questions about these terms or any other matter, you can reach Essential Software by sending a mail to @Blank through the app's mail screen.

Message Backups

      
    

    

      
Messages you send and receive are end-to-end encrypted — only your device and the recipient's device hold the keys to decrypt them, so Essential Software can't read them at any point.

      
A backup file you download here is different: it stores your messages already decrypted, in plain readable text, so you can restore them later. Store the file somewhere private, and be careful about who you share it with — anyone who opens it can read your messages.
